thread:
Alice: late-morning oncall handoff — quick async check. Current incidents: INC-5432 (eu-west1 embedding ingest backlog), INC-5433 (kvcache thrash on ded-wk2). Short bullets + owners below.

Alice: INC-5432 summary — embedding-ingest queue spiking after a bad batch job. Autoscaler didn't add pods due to new HPA minReplicas bug (seen on ded config). Mitigation: rolled traffic to embed-v1-fallback, paused batch job. Owner: Ben.

Ben: ack. I paused the batch and opened a PR to fix the HPA controller config (link: https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/4321). Will push a hotfix if we still see scale issues in 15m. :thumbsup:

Carla: logs I see are a lot of OOMs on ded-wk2-1; could be memory leak in the ingest worker. Added a memory limit override to the pod spec as temporary. Link to logs: https://logs.redwood/eu-west1/ingest/INC-5432

Dan: added a short-term routing rule to avoid ded-wk2 until we complete restart. Command run:
```bash
kubectl label nodes ded-wk2-1 maintenance=true && ./routerctl drain-node ded-wk2-1
```
No traffic to ded-wk2 now.

Alice: INC-5433 — kvcache thrash (high eviction + tail latency) on ded-wk2 pool. Symptoms: sudden regen spike, frequent cache fills/evictions. Mitigation applied: lowered in-memory cache size from 48GB -> 32GB and bumped eviction threshold. Rolling restart started. Owner: Dan.

Ben: FYI, the canary we had for embed-v2 showed a 95p latency increase ~5% on regen paths. deploy-bot triggered an auto-fallback to embed-v1-fallback for canary traffic.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback executed for model/embed-v2 -> embed-v1-fallback at 2026-03-17T09:25:10Z due to 95p latency > 1.2s. Reason: unexpected kvcache eviction pattern.

Carla: requesting traces for one of the sample requests that timed out. Alice, can you paste a request id from the log?

Alice: example request id: req_5712b9f2. Relevant log snippet:
```
2026-03-17T09:18:42Z ERROR ingest.worker: request=req_5712b9f2 kvcache: eviction_count=142 latency_ms=1420
2026-03-17T09:18:42Z WARN  runtime.dispatch: falling back to model-serial exec path
```

Ben: I'll pick up traces and add a quick eval to reproduce locally. Also pinging @Carla for a memory profile after the restart completes.

Dan: restart finished on ded-wk2-1, node came up healthy. Eviction rate is down ~60% in the last 10m. Monitoring shows 95p latency improving but keep an eye on regen SLO.

Alice: outstanding actions:
- Ben: HPA hotfix PR and trace + eval reproduction (ETA 30m)
- Dan: monitor kvcache eviction + follow up if eviction rate > 20/min (I put an alert)
- Carla: confirm memory profile after rolling restart and comment on PR if changes needed

Alice: small housekeeping: pinging for code review on infra PR #4321 and runtime PR #289 (regen backpressure tweak). If you can review, add quick comments — these are on the critical path for tonight's capacity.

Ben: on it, aiming to review within the hour.

Carla: will run the memory profile and post results here.

Alice: I'll be on-call for another 2.5h, reachable on pager and </call-me>. If anything regresses, create a new incident thread and tag me. Thanks all. :heart:
